title: The batch runner may push a plain merge of main into a handed-in PR branch
ruling: Owner 2026-11-13 13:12 CST, answer "a" to the coordinator's standing-grant question, relayed by the coordinator: the batch runner may push a plain merge of main into a handed-in PR branch when no lane has pushed there in 2 h. No rebase, no force push. A conflict that changes behaviour goes back to the coordinator. Each new head gets a fix check and a fresh record.
